item: the stream's per-event stop check reads the lane setting once per 2 s, not once per firehose event
summary: Windows run 2026-11-07: oo-wiki-stream was the third busiest thread (904 CPU-s in one hour) because the stream's stop check read the settings for every event of the whole recent-change firehose. WikiLaneRunner._stream_should_stop reuses a keep-going answer for STATE_READ_TTL_S (2 s, monotonic, injected clock); a stop is never cached, the runner's own stop event is read live, an unreadable setting stops at once, the kill switch and airplane mode are still read per event by the stream. Stated trade: the operator's Stop or Pause is seen within 2 s. The data_dir() half (mkdir, chmod, stat on every call) is src/paths.py, owned by the orphans lane.
